correctness.rationale: All quantified identities follow from (i) bijective counting of proper colorings by exact singleton blocks, (ii) the finite-graph Stanley orientation evaluation at -1, (iii) expansion of sink indicators and a bijection for any independent forced-sink set, and (iv) a disjoint classification of crown independent sets. The Q3 cubic discriminant is computed exactly as -50430544. Fresh standalone verifier compares 72 independent brute colorings, all 4164 orientations across n=2,3,4, six multivariate substitutions, and explicit coefficients to n=6. Finite checks corroborate but do not replace the proofs.

value.rationale: The exact labeled-sink distribution of a natural symmetric but non-complete bipartite family is mathematically motivated by sink-count refinements of acyclic-orientation enumerators; it answers all prescribed-sink questions for every order in a compact restricted-Stirling evaluation. The 3-cube corollary is a concrete nonreal-rootedness boundary for a well-studied graph polynomial on a highly symmetric bipartite graph, not a normalization check or arbitrary parameter slice. Independent scrutiny remains outstanding.
